reviewed_by: Codex review of October 13 mobile workspace audit failure and screenshot
reason: At 320 px the Findings header's Workbench back label and redundant sidebar control consume the room needed for its New finding action, leaving half the 44 px button clipped. Quiet Lens also hides all page actions when its mobile top menu opens. The narrow viewport keeps an accessible, titled back icon, hides the sidebar control, and reveals page actions in the open Quiet Lens top menu. Seven narrow visual/navigation/accessibility cases and one mobile WebKit audit cover the mock shell. The selected production LAN Core test checks the full Finding action, failure, retry, and reload journey at 320 px WebKit, including unclipped 44 px geometry in the default theme.
exclusions: This changes narrow mobile shell geometry and Quiet Lens page-action visibility. Python, native, frontend unit, desktop, unrelated browser areas, and a full suite are excluded. Browser viewports are emulated; no physical device is available.
